headline: U.S. Federal Reserve Expected to Hold Interest Rates Steady
summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve appears set to hold interest rates steady at its upcoming meeting, despite stubbornly high inflation and market pricing for future hikes.
why: Federal Reserve monetary policy decisions set global benchmark interest rates, influencing equity valuations, bond yields, and currency flows worldwide.

impacts.name: Global Fixed Income
impacts.why: Holding rates steady amid persistent inflation prompts reassessments of bond yields and future monetary easing paths.

why_moved: Expectations of a rate pause despite high inflation impact short-term Treasury yields and rate-sensitive equity sectors.
